description: This file contains utility functions for access control and permission checks related to datasets, charts, and queries within the Superset project. It defines functions to verify user permissions for datasets, queries, and charts, and handles exceptions for access denial and not found errors.

methods.name: check_dataset_access
methods.description: Verifies if the dataset with the given ID can be accessed by the current user, raising an error if not found or access is denied.

methods.name: check_query_access
methods.description: Verifies if the query with the given ID can be accessed by the current user, raising an error if not found or access is denied.

methods.name: check_datasource_access
methods.description: Checks access for a datasource based on its ID and type, raising an error if invalid or not found.

methods.name: check_access
methods.description: Performs comprehensive access check for a datasource and optionally a chart, raising errors if access is denied or entities are not found.
